        int recursiveSolve(int level, int need, int previous) {
            if (level == R) {

            if (storage[level].containsKey(key)) {

            int total = 1 << C;
            for (int pattern = 0; pattern < total; pattern++) {
                int cur = 0;
                for (int pos = 0; pos < C; pos++) {
                    if (((pattern >> pos) & 1) == 1) {

                    int futureCost = countBits(cur) + recursiveSolve(level + 1, futureNeed, cur);
                    if (futureCost < minVal) minVal = futureCost;
